args.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.
Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: character model sheet, S22 front.png. Generate a native landscape 1536×1024 PNG. Single character only, complete head-to-toe straight front view filling 94% of the canvas height, centred, no inset or second figure, no scale silhouette. Flat uniform light-grey #E9E9EC from edge to edge with no vignette, texture or gradient. Soft neutral key light from upper left, no backlight, no glow. Orthographic model-sheet camera with level verticals and no foreshortening. Quiet balanced neutral stance, arms held slightly clear of hips, both empty gloved hands fully visible with all five digits anatomically readable. Small kind crooked grin.
Oh Minseok: a Korean man in his late thirties with a kind, crooked grin and short hair going grey, a scar through one eyebrow; an old, heavily patched safety-orange trap-tester vest over a grey hoodie; fingerless gloves.
Established production decisions for Oh Minseok: a lean, wiry working man, 176 cm, 7.5–8 heads tall, adult legs half his total height. A broad oblong weathered face with a rounded-square jaw, broad straight nose, warm dark-brown eyes, crow's-feet, a wider mouth whose LEFT corner lifts higher in a crooked grin; close-cropped dark hair grizzled grey at both temples and crown. One slim healed diagonal scar cuts through his anatomical RIGHT eyebrow (picture-left in front). He is visibly older and more open-faced than Jaeha, without Jaeha's fringe, pencil or notebook. Clean-shaven. Safety-orange vest #F26A1B / #C14F12 over grey hoodie #8E9198 / #6B6E77, hood down. Two horizontal silver reflective bands #D5D9DD cross the vest around waist and lower torso; two flapped chest pockets and two flapped hip pockets. A purposefully repaired vest with four large rectangular cloth mends only: muted charcoal on RIGHT upper chest, faded orange on LEFT lower chest, grey on RIGHT hip pocket, faded orange on LEFT hem. The mends are flat sewn-on cloth rectangles with sparse perimeter stitches, not lettering or emblems. No T or other glyph on Minseok. Black fingerless work gloves, dark navy cargo work trousers #2A3142 with grey knee patches, plain black steel-toe boots. No other equipment.
Keep clean graphic inking and broad opaque cel-shadow shapes, no grain or photographic texture, no hatch shading on garments. Cloth patches are deliberate large practical repairs. Safety reflective bands are required functional gear, the only clothing stripes. Small contact shadows immediately under soles only. No drawn floor line. Natural adult proportions, no shortened legs, no oversized head. His orange vest is the warm signature colour; model sheets use local colours (the grey flashback treatment belongs to later panels).
No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.

calls.review: Pass: 7.5–8 head adult proportions; short salt-and-pepper hair; healed scar through anatomical right eyebrow; crooked kind grin; four deliberate vest mends; blank Minseok vest, two reflective bands, no scale figure. Background visually quiet; slight tone difference is permitted by 27 October override.
